name: Word Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type, with live limits for posts, messages and search snippets.
facts: Counts words, characters with and without spaces, sentences and paragraphs live as you type
Estimates reading time at 238 words per minute and speaking time at 150 words per minute
Shows how close the text is to common limits: 280 characters for a short social post, 160 for a search result description, 160 for a text message, 2200 for a photo caption
Lists the eight most used words, ignoring common filler words
Works on pasted text of any language that uses spaces or that the browser can segment into words
Runs entirely in the browser; the text is never uploaded or stored
Has buttons for sample text, copying a one-line summary and clearing everything
limits: Word segmentation for languages without spaces depends on the browser's built-in segmenter
The limit meters count characters, not bytes, and platforms may count emoji or links differently
Reading and speaking times are averages, not predictions for one person
use_cases: checking an essay against a word limit
